title: Implement goal domain package
objective: Implement the small goal package that satisfies the domain contract tests.
context: This package is the shared state model for slash commands, tools, session metadata, prompt context, and loop continuation.

source_evidence.note: SessionMeta can persist a Goal value later if the type has JSON tags.

include: Pure transition helpers for create, edit, pause, resume, achieve, block, and clear.

implementation_steps: Add types and transition helpers demanded by tests.
Use time injection only if tests need deterministic timestamps.
Run package tests and keep the API compact.
acceptance_criteria: The package has no import cycle with session, commands, loop, or tools.
The public API can be used by both commands and model tools.
risks: Import cycles if this package reaches into runtime packages.
dispatch_prompt: Implement goal/goal.go to satisfy goal/goal_test.go. Keep it a pure domain package with JSON tags and no runtime dependencies.
notes_for_assignee: If tests over-specify the API, shrink implementation without broadening scope.
